title: 2022 CODATA: molar gas constant is 8.314 462 618...
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks molar gas constant as exact: 8.314 462 618...
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks molar gas constant as exact: 8.314 462 618... J mol^-1 K^-1. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. This is the molar gas constant R in the 2022 listing. It is marked exact. The ellipsis means the printed digits are not a cutoff added here.
